entries.name: alloc ldt descriptors
entries.description: Allocates CX consecutive descriptors in the local descriptor table and returns the first selector.
entries.behaviour: CX = number of descriptors. CF clear: AX = base selector, and base and limit of each are 0 with type data; add the AX=0003h increment to reach later ones. CF set: AX = error code (DPMI 1.0+).

entries.behaviour: CF clear: BX:CX = page size in bytes. CF set: AX = error code (DPMI 1.0+), including 8001h for a 16-bit host. The list notes that the Borland C++ 3.1 DPMILOAD returns CF clear with BX and CX unchanged.

against.line: INT 31 P - DPMI 0.9+ - GET PAGE SIZE

entries.name: mark demand paging
entries.description: Marks a byte range as a candidate for demand paging.
entries.behaviour: BX:CX = starting linear address, SI:DI = number of bytes. CF set: AX=8025h (DPMI 1.0+). The call is advisory and forces no immediate paging; partial pages are not discarded.

against.line: INT 31 P - DPMI 0.9+ - MARK PAGE AS DEMAND PAGING CANDIDATE

entries.name: discard page contents
entries.description: Marks the contents of a byte range as discarded.
entries.behaviour: BX:CX = starting linear address, SI:DI = number of bytes. CF set: AX=8025h (DPMI 1.0+). The call is advisory and may be ignored by the host; partial pages are not discarded.

entries.name: map physical address
entries.description: Maps physical memory, normally above 1 MB, to a linear address.
entries.behaviour: BX:CX = physical address, SI:DI = size in bytes. CF clear: BX:CX = linear address and the caller must build a selector; CF set: AX=8003h or 8021h (DPMI 1.0+). The host may refuse it; do not use it for the first megabyte.

entries.name: free physical mapping
entries.description: Frees a mapping made by AX=0800h (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: BX:CX = linear address returned by AX=0800h. CF clear on success; CF set: AX=8025h. Call it when access to the device ends.

entries.name: disable virtual ints
entries.description: Disables the virtual interrupt state and returns the previous state.
entries.behaviour: CF clear; AL = previous state (00h disabled, 01h enabled), AH preserved. Another INT 31h call restores the old state; a CLI also works but traps to the host and is slow.

entries.name: enable virtual ints
entries.description: Enables the virtual interrupt state and returns the previous state.
entries.behaviour: CF clear; AL = previous state (00h disabled, 01h enabled), AH preserved. Another INT 31h call restores the old state; a STI also works but traps to the host and is slow.

entries.name: get virtual int state
entries.description: Returns the current virtual interrupt state.
entries.behaviour: CF clear; AL = state (00h disabled, 01h enabled). Use it instead of PUSHF, which yields the physical state and not the per-client virtualized interrupt flag.

entries.name: get vendor api
entries.description: Returns the extended API entry point for a vendor name.
entries.behaviour: DS:(E)SI -> case-sensitive ASCIZ vendor name. CF clear: ES:(E)DI -> far entry point, with DS, FS, GS, EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI and EBP destroyed; CF set: AX=8001h (DPMI 1.0+). DPMI 1.0+ prefers INT 2Fh AX=168Ah.

entries.description: Sets a debug watchpoint at a linear address.
entries.behaviour: BX:CX = linear address, DL = size (1, 2 or 4), DH = type (00h execute, 01h write, 02h read/write). CF clear: BX = watchpoint handle. CF set: AX=8016h, 8021h or 8025h (DPMI 1.0+).

entries.name: install tsr init
entries.description: Declares an intent to provide resident protected mode services (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: ES:(E)DI -> resident service provider structure: 16-bit and 32-bit data and code descriptors plus callback offsets. CF set: AX=8015h, 8021h or 8025h. A later AX=0C01h keeps the services resident.

entries.name: terminate and stay
entries.description: Ends the program but keeps its resident protected mode services (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: BL = return code, DX = paragraphs of DOS memory to keep (0 or at least 6). It never returns. Without a prior AX=0C00h the program is simply terminated; protected mode memory not freed first stays allocated.

entries.name: alloc shared memory
entries.description: Allocates a named shared memory block (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: ES:(E)DI -> request structure: requested length, then returned length, handle and linear address, and a name pointer. CF set: AX=8012h-8014h, 8016h or 8021h. The first 16 bytes are zeroed on first allocation.

entries.name: free shared memory
entries.description: Frees a shared memory block by handle (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: SI:DI = handle. CF set: AX=8023h. The handle becomes invalid; the block is destroyed when its global use count reaches zero, counted apart from the per-machine count.

entries.name: serialize shared mem
entries.description: Serializes access to a shared memory block, exclusive or shared (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: SI:DI = handle, DX bit 0 = return at once if unavailable, bit 1 = shared instead of exclusive. CF set: AX=8004h, 8005h, 8017h-8019h or 8023h. Hosts need not detect deadlock; AX=0D03h cancels a blocked call.

entries.name: free serialization
entries.description: Releases serialization on a shared memory block (DPMI 1.0).
entries.behaviour: SI:DI = handle, DX bit 0 = release shared instead of exclusive serialization, bit 1 = free pending serialization. CF set: AX=8002h or 8023h.

entries.behaviour: BX bit 0 = enable the coprocessor for the client, bit 1 = the client will emulate it. CF set: AX=8026h.
